verdict.rationale: Evidence shows real ecosystem breadth—llama.cpp (community C++ runtime), Hugging Face hosting in multiple formats, and broad partner hosting (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, etc.)—plus community adoption commentary confirming production use across major clouds. However, there is no evidence of curated community lists, third-party routers, or examples of active third-party maintainers/tooling beyond Meta's own official repos and known runtime ports. missing for 10: curated 'awesome-llama' style lists, third-party router/integration tools (e.g., LiteLLM, OpenRouter), explicit evidence of active independent maintainers.
